plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, English - Creative Writing Emphasis BA/BS graduation plan text PDF (program awarded as BA/BS; the published plan includes the BA foreign-language sequence). Semester totals as printed: 16 / 16 / 16 / 16 / 15 / 15 / 13 / 12 = 119, matching the printed 'Total Hours 119'. ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN) and ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN) verified against the official 2025-2026 program texts. All other ENGL course slots (ENGL 1410, 2250R, 2400/2410/2500/2510, 2600, 3030, 3140, 3141, 3142, 3145, 3220, 3810, 4700), 'Elective(s)', and 'Foreign Language (Beginning I/II, Intermediate I/II)' are choice placeholders (credits as printed); titles not shown in the graduation plan — see the 2025-2026 catalog course descriptions. 'Creative Writing Emphasis Elective' slots (numbered 1-3) are choice placeholders for emphasis courses — see the program text for the eligible list. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
